rh.code_paper_alignment.scheme.reason: The S1 benchmark is repeatedly described as dynamically neutral with no static background. Its implementation instead adds a nonzero uniform jellium background to compensate the finite-time-step charge imbalance. At the production resolution this background density is approximately 0.00119959. Although small, this directly contradicts the stated neutralization mechanism; the finding does not imply that the underlying update is nonvariational.
evidence: proposal/report.tex:374–376, 749–756, 927–929 explicitly state that S1 has no static background.
proposal/code/runs/run_S1.py:41–57 initializes the species and assigns sim.rho_bg[:] = -rho0.mean(), explicitly describing compensation by uniform jellium.
proposal/logs/S1/dx0.04_spectra.npz, Q_series[0] = -0.024567645437830958 in a box of length 20.48, corroborates the nonzero matter-charge imbalance.

rh.code_paper_alignment.gauge.reason: The report claims that the quenched B1 runs respect the stated Gauss constraint by construction. The implementation freezes zero dynamical electric fields without solving Gauss or adding a neutralizing background, while a saved realization has nonzero total matter charge. Thus the stated constraint cannot hold in that realization. This finding concerns the claimed preservation property, not the scientific acceptability of the disclosed quenched approximation.
evidence: proposal/report.tex:266–269 defines div(E) = rho + rho_bg; lines 531–534 and 586–589 claim unchanged conservation properties and Gauss preservation in quenched runs.
proposal/code/runs/run_B1.py:69–76 solves Gauss and supplies a background only when backreact=True; otherwise it sets freeze_gauge=True and g0=NaN.
proposal/code/qedlat/core.py:252–260 initializes electric fields and rho_bg to zero; lines 106–127 and 156–159 skip gauge updates when frozen.
proposal/logs/B1/eps1_spectrum.npz, Q_series[0] = 5.03511662813729. With length 51.2 and no background, the spatially averaged Gauss residual has magnitude approximately 0.09834, rather than zero.
